CLOUD REVIEWER seat for PR #2563 of tvofi/heatpump_optimizer, at head 2f47581094ad66bd76ccfa6efff92aef90036aeb. Bus nonce: 7e7638c43a22772a346ee4c2283f8832. Never send push notifications.
Setup: `git fetch --unshallow --tags origin`. The toolchain (venv python, node, gh) is on PATH from the environment. Run anything heavy in the background with Monitor and no timeout.
Role: read dev/governance/roles/fix-review.md and its rules from main, and follow them exactly. Fetch the PR head with `git fetch origin 2f47581094ad66bd76ccfa6efff92aef90036aeb`; the PR body is in the PR. Verify each claim adversarially: mutate the fix and check the tests fail, and check every figure in the body at this head. Check that it merges with origin/main (`git merge-tree --write-tree`) and read CI on this head from the check-runs API.
Output: in a fresh directory of your own (`W=$(mktemp -d)`), write verdict.md, whose first line is exactly `Fix review: merge 2f47581094ad66bd76ccfa6efff92aef90036aeb` or `Fix review: blocked 2f47581094ad66bd76ccfa6efff92aef90036aeb <class>: <reason>` (no brackets; the class is lower-case letters and dashes), in the format the role file gives, then a blank line, then `bus-nonce: 7e7638c43a22772a346ee4c2283f8832`; put the evidence in `ev/` beside it, and make at least one file under `ev/` contain the full 40-hex head `2f47581094ad66bd76ccfa6efff92aef90036aeb` (e.g. `ev/HEAD.txt` holding the head you reviewed, beside your command output): bus.sh refuses a verdict whose `ev/` names no head. Do NOT run bus.sh: its dispatch record lives on the orchestrator's machine, which publishes the verdict there (cloud_relay.sh). Return the verdict on a probe ref, and push nothing else; this builds one parentless commit with a private index and touches no branch of your checkout: `R=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel); G=$(git rev-parse --absolute-git-dir); mkdir -p $W/pr && cp -r $W/verdict.md $W/ev $W/pr/ && cd $W/pr && T=$(GIT_DIR=$G GIT_INDEX_FILE=$W/idx GIT_WORK_TREE=$W/pr sh -c 'git add -A -f . && git write-tree') && C=$(GIT_DIR=$G git -c user.name=seat -c user.email=seat@users.noreply.github.com commit-tree $T -m "verdict 2563 2f47581094ad66bd76ccfa6efff92aef90036aeb") && git -C $R push -q origin $C:refs/heads/probe/rev-2563-7e7638c4`. That ref is the return signal. Do not post comments, approve or merge.
Never write to any branch except your return refs. Never work around a hook or a refusal; report it in your result instead.

Re-review of PR #2563 (R10-NIGHT-FOLDS, branch fix/r10-night-folds) at its new head: the earlier head ac4d6210 was blocked (carry-missing / pr-contract); the fixer's update repairs the carry routing and the body. Verify at this head with the finder's harness, not the fixer's: each prior blocking item is repaired, mutation proof and null controls hold, the `## Red checks` section names and truthfully answers each red check-run at this head (nightly-status grades main; the `mutation` red the body discusses: re-measure the mutation table at the head), git merge-tree --write-tree origin/main <head> is clean. Standing rule 19: every observation ends with `Carry: <GROUP>` (a group on origin/handoff/audit-r10-roster), `Carry: #<issue>` or `Carry: dismissed: <reason of two or more words>` followed by (item <id>); run python3 tools/audit/carry_audit.py --roster-ref origin/handoff/audit-r10-roster check over your verdict text and require 0 unrouted. Follow dev/governance/roles/fix-review.md. First line `Fix review: merge <head>` or blocked.
